name: ai4u-router-mobile
description: Android-first mobile package for the existing AI4U Right-Tool Routing OS

scripts.android:add: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
